text: Fotor for DeepSeek Harness 是一款面向 DSH Web 和 CLI 的 Fotor 媒体插件，通过原生适配器加载技能目录并连接 Fotor MCP 服务。它把图像生成与编辑、图像放大和背景移除、文本或参考素材生成视频，以及音乐创作、语音合成和音频处理能力提供给 DSH 工具。用户可按任务查询可用模型和参数，准备本地素材并提交相应媒体任务。适合希望在 DSH 对话中使用 Fotor 媒体能力的创作者；连接服务需要 Fotor 授权，并需本机支持的 Node.js 版本。

Fotor for DeepSeek Harness connects DSH to Fotor through native skill and MCP adapters. It supports image generation and editing, video creation, and audio workflows. Users can discover models, prepare media, and submit tasks in DSH. Fotor authorization and a supported Node.js version are required.

Fotor 的图像处理功能：通过 MCP 工具生成或编辑图片，也可单独放大图片或移除背景。生成和编辑使用所选模型及其支持参数；放大和去背景接收图片 URL 并返回任务结果。
Fotor 的视频生成功能：根据文字、首帧、首尾帧或多模态参考素材提交视频任务。用户选择视频模式和模型，提供提示词及可访问的素材 URL，获得生成任务结果。
Fotor 的音频功能：可创作配乐或新曲、延长和编辑歌曲、合成语音或播客，并分离人声与伴奏。用户按操作提供音频、文字或参考素材，服务返回音频文件或任务结果。
Fotor 的素材上传功能：将本地图片、视频或音频上传到 Fotor，返回可供后续媒体任务使用的文件 URL；也可单独上传并查看每个文件的上传结果。
Fotor MCP 连接使用 https://mcp.fotor.com/mcp；首次或授权失效时可能需要在浏览器完成服务授权，用户需有可用的 Fotor 账户。
插件连接依赖本机支持的 Node.js（24.2+ 的 24.x 或 26.x），并默认使用本机 3335 端口进行授权回调。

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Verification scope：Package checks cover files, references, and configuration. Verify installation, MCP authorization and calls, website login, credit links, uploads, and media execution separately in the selected host and environment. A release or model query does not establish successful website login or completed media results.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Verification scope：The Bundle supplies two small native Host adapters that configure the host-owned components automatically. The bridge is acquired by the package manager and owns OAuth. npm artifacts carry its full runtime dependency tree; Git installs download the dependency. Complete support requires real controlled reauthorization recovery as well as installation, calls, website access and restart reuse; consult the evidence for the installed release. Media execution and expiry-driven refresh are not established by static checks.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness：DeepSeek Harness is abbreviated as `dsh` in commands and native identifiers.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：First verify that the selected revision contains the DeepSeek Harness Bundle. Install this scoped package and its pinned bridge dependency to the chosen profile. Select Web **Enable now** or load the CLI profile; both components then configure automatically unless explicit user settings disable them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin.git" --ignore-scripts
```

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：This is the standalone root Bundle for [https://github.com/fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin](https://github.com/fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin). Use its root Git source only after the selected channel contains this version. The [multi-platform repository](https://github.com/fotor-ai/fotor-agent-plugins) documents this external source; it no longer distributes new DeepSeek Harness packages. Existing subdirectory installations require a one-way native source migration.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：The Bundle identity is `@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin`. After the corresponding npm channel is published, its alternative is `dsh plugin --profile web add "@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin" --ignore-scripts` (production) or `dsh plugin --profile web add "@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin@next" --ignore-scripts` (test). Verify the resolved version and select one source only. Bare-name npm installation follows `latest`.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：Installation automatically obtains **mcp-remote 0.15.2**. Git sources download it through the host package manager; npm artifacts carry its complete locked runtime tree. Fotor skills remain script-free. No installation hook runs code; host activation starts connection and may open browser consent. Node is not bundled.

Follow the [complete installation guide](INSTALL.md):

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：1. Check Linux DeepSeek Harness Web `0.2.1-rc.3` and stable Node **24.2.0 or later within 24.x, or 26.x**.
2. Install one source with lifecycle scripts disabled.
3. In Web, click **Enable now** after installation; in CLI, start the selected profile. Both enabled-by-default adapters resolve their paths automatically.
4. Complete browser consent when required; existing valid authorization is reused.
5. Verify actual skill and tool discovery. Configure the model account separately; website access is a separate request.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：The declared host range is `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`; matching versions are not automatically verified. Desktop, headless and ACP require separate acceptance.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness configuration and connection：The native adapters resolve skills, Node and the pinned bridge at activation. Existing explicit overrides and disabled states take precedence. The [full configuration example](configuration.example.yml) is optional and never auto-applied. Overrides replace complete `config` objects. Keep default skill roots and native MCP reconnect disabled.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness configuration and connection：Credentials remain outside the installation, in the configured `MCP_REMOTE_CONFIG_DIR` or the active profile's dedicated Fotor directory. Follow [authentication instructions](skills/fotor-connect/references/authentication.md). The adapter runs client discovery, closes that client and its callback, then starts the native MCP proxy. User consent remains required; disabling MCP cancels its connection task.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness configuration and connection：Use the user's confirmed daily ordinary browser. MCP-only requests do not request website links; website requests prepare the browser, open the original handoff once through native permission controls, and wait for actual page confirmation. An existing login is not a first-login result.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness updates：For a recorded Git source:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update @fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin --ignore-scripts
dsh plugin --profile web why @fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin
```

For a recorded npm source, replace `<target-version>` with the approved, published version:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update "@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin@<target-version>" --ignore-scripts
```

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness updates：During historical 0.6.0-test.2 acceptance, immediate `@next` updates retained 0.6.0-test.1; exact-version native updates passed. An unqualified update can also retain the saved version. Neither `@latest` update success nor eventual success after 24 hours is established. Use the [maintenance procedure](INSTALL.md#7-use-update-or-remove-fotor); keep release-age protection and request separate approval for any exact-version exception. Never apply an npm selector to a Git source as an ordinary update.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · DeepSeek Harness updates：Verify the source, version, files and actual skill/bridge directories in a new process. Preserve profile/store, credentials and connection parameters. If installation used a custom `--store-dir`, pass that same argument to updates and removal. A zero exit code with the old version is not an upgrade; cache clearing or reinstall does not turn it into a pass.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Production release：First verify that the selected revision contains the DeepSeek Harness Bundle. Install this scoped package and its pinned bridge dependency to the chosen profile. Select Web **Enable now** or load the CLI profile; both components then configure automatically unless explicit user settings disable them. Record the old source and scope, remove only this Fotor Bundle through native controls, then add the selected source. Preserve the external credential directory and valid overrides; verify automatically resolved paths when enabling the new package.

Install this scoped package and its pinned bridge dependency to the chosen profile. Select Web **Enable now** or load the CLI profile; both components then configure automatically unless explicit user settings disable them. Record the old source and scope, remove only this Fotor Bundle through native controls, then add the selected source. @fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Test release：Legacy `fotor` and scoped packages are different identities. Stop Fotor components and record old source/profile/store/paths and explicit overrides, then remove the old Bundle with `dsh plugin --profile web remove fotor --config.ignore-scripts=true`. Add one scoped source. Version 0.6.1 resolves its runtime paths automatically unless explicit overrides apply; preserve valid values and correct or remove only obsolete path overrides through native configuration. Preserve disabled settings, model settings, the external credential directory, callback/security parameters and daily browser state; do not automatically remove the old external bridge.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Test release：GitHub/npm switching uses the same explicit remove/add sequence, with `@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin` as the removal target. Keep one installed source and one component pair. Ordinary update does not rename packages or switch sources. See [maintenance](INSTALL.md#7-use-update-or-remove-fotor).

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Test release：Uninstall retains external credentials but does not revoke server consent. Same-profile reinstall can reuse accepted authorization; enabling still establishes a new connection that requires actual discovery/query verification. Expired or rejected credentials may need new consent. Reinstall is not evidence of a successful native upgrade.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Workflows：Start with [connection and model discovery](skills/fotor-connect/references/mcp-integration.md#runtime-workflow), then select the skill matching the request. Follow [media preparation](skills/fotor-connect/references/media-upload.md) for local references and [credits](skills/fotor-connect/references/credits.md) to query your own Fotor credit balance. These instructions do not establish host acceptance of every media operation.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Bundle contents：- `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`: the Bundle and two enabled-by-default adapters.
- `configuration.example.yml`: optional complete legacy override; never auto-applied.
- `INSTALL.md`: self-contained setup and migration guide.
- `package-lock.json`: reviewed npm release-build input in Git snapshots; not a host-level Git dependency lock.
- `runtime/`: automatic configuration and cancellable connection ownership; no installation hooks.
- npm artifacts additionally contain the pinned third-party runtime; Fotor skills remain script-free.
- `.github/`: Git snapshot publication tooling, excluded from installed packages.
- `skills/`, including each skill's `references/`: shared workflows and DeepSeek Harness bridge/browser guidance.
- `assets/logo.svg`, `README.md` and `LICENSE`: package-local documentation and branding.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Skill-local references：Audio workflows cover soundtrack composition, new tracks, song editing, speech, podcasts and vocal separation. Consult the installed audio skill when available. The host deadline and generated bridge header/body timeouts default to 300 seconds. See [tool call timeouts](INSTALL.md#tool-call-timeouts) for scopes and overrides. A deadline is not confirmation that a task failed; preserve any known ID without automatic resubmission.

@fotor-ai/dsh-fotor-plugin README · Skill-local references：Every packaged skill carries four generated documents in its own `references/` directory, including this platform's authentication guide. Read them as needed; complete runtime documentation does not install or configure MCP.
